title: N6.8 — Storage aislado — Aplicación, servicios y API

verified_material_progress.result: StorageTenantContext can now be constructed from UsuarioTenantScopeActual resolved server-side by IUsuarioScopeService.
Tenant company logo upload/delete now use tenant-aware image-storage overloads derived from verified membership rather than legacy unscoped calls.
Directed service test requires tenant-scoped storage for tenant logos and forbids fallback to legacy upload.
Tenant image downloads are pinned to HTTPS res.cloudinary.com and the configured Cloudinary account before tenant-path validation, closing a forged-origin/SSRF class gap.
Directed negative tests reject foreign origin, wrong Cloudinary account and cross-tenant locators.

p1_findings.finding: ProductoService still calls legacy IImageStorageService UploadAsync/DeleteAsync and Producto has no authoritative EmpresaId binding. The N6.8.A inventario requires private product-image mutations to resolve EmpresaId authoritatively before storage mutation.
p1_findings.next_action: Introduce or reuse an authoritative server-side Producto-to-Empresa ownership binding, then migrate product image mutations to StorageTenantContext. Do not accept client EmpresaId/folder as authority.

p1_findings.finding: CompraDocumentoService still calls legacy upload/download/delete storage methods; Compra currently lacks an authoritative EmpresaId binding. N6.8.A classifies these documents as PRIVATE_TENANT_DOCUMENT and requires fail-closed tenant ownership before every storage operation.
p1_findings.next_action: Establish authoritative Compra tenant ownership and route document upload/download/delete through tenant-aware ICompraDocumentoStorageService overloads with mismatch rejection.

p1_findings.finding: Factura/IFacturaPdfService still do not carry an authoritative tenant context; N6.8.A explicitly requires N6.8.D to preserve server-resolved EmpresaId through PDF/Excel generation and persisted/download authorization.
p1_findings.next_action: Bind invoice/export generation to authoritative EmpresaId and propagate verified tenant context through private generated deliverables without trusting client tenant identifiers.

http_problem_details.reason: No HTTP response contract was changed by the material commits reviewed here.

frontend.reason: N6.8.D is BACKEND_API; N6.8.E owns frontend/UX.

closure_candidate.reason: P1=3; a closure candidate cannot be frozen until all actionable P1 findings are resolved and directed causal validation passes.
